name: page-head
description: The 60px bar under the nav bar of a work page: the page's title and its main action on the left, secondary actions on the right, one hairline underneath.

props.name: title
props.description: Page title (an h1), cut with an ellipsis when it is too long.

props.name: main_action
props.description: Label of the text button next to the title.

rationale: Height is spacing.9 + spacing.6 (60px), side padding spacing.6 (20px), bg.surface with one hairline (object-dark.passive) under it. The title is the heading-4 role (Inter SemiBold 20px) with line-height normal, so the bar's height, not the type scale, sets the rhythm. The gap between title and main action is spacing.cell (10px); the right group has no gap because text buttons hug their labels (see text-button). Both groups are flex rows with min-width 0, so a long title ellipsizes instead of pushing the actions out. Rendering verified in light and dark themes.
a11y_notes: The title is an h1. The buttons are real text-buttons; keyboard focus uses their own ring.
